responses.text: {at Bunker - no plan} What are you talking to me for? Talk to Kreger.
{At Hoover Dam battle} Now is {emphasis "not"} not the time!
{Player not in NCR gear} Bah. Looks like I forgot to lock the doors again. If you're with the NCR, get out. This place is mine, and I'm not leaving.
{Player in NCR gear} Look, trooper, I was living in this house long before your farms got set up. {threat} Don't even think about evicting me.
{Remnants helping NCR} I didn't come all the way out here just so we could save the fucking NCR. I'm out.
{Moreno convinced to stay} I can't believe I'm going to help the NCR.
{Remnants helping Legion} Since Johnson won't be coming with us, you might as well take his suit of Power Armor. I'll teach you the basics of how to use it.
{terse} Yeah?

topics.prompt: GREETING

responses.text: {dismissive grunt} Hmmph.

topics.prompt: Goodbye.

responses.text: {to player's companion} Been awhile, Arcade. {to player} So, what's the point of all this? Can't find any younger mercenaries?

topics.prompt: {Arcade hired}Arcade and I were looking for you. We're gathering the Remnants.

responses.text: Arcade, huh? Heard he was with the Followers of the Apocalypse. So, what's the point of all this? Can't find any younger mercenaries?

topics.prompt: {Arcade not hired}Arcade sent me to look for you. I'm gathering the Remnants.

responses.text: {cynical chuckle} Oh, like you wouldn't believe. The NCR makes a habit out of wrecking homes. I came out here to get away from them - didn't work out so well.
Next thing I know, I'm squatting in {emphasis "their"} "their" land. {irritation} Never mind that I'd already been living here for years.

topics.prompt: Do you have something against the NCR?

responses.text: Do? I don't do anything. I'm retired.

topics.prompt: What do you do around here?

responses.text: Is that right? The million dollar question is who exactly are we "settling?"

topics.prompt: Your advanced level of tech would be useful in settling things between the NCR and the Legion.

responses.text: {bitterly} You can thank the NCR for that one. {sudden thought} Wait - this isn't on behalf of the NCR, is it?

topics.prompt: There isn't anyone else around with your equipment and expertise.

responses.text: {sarcasm} You're doing a fine job of convincing me to go along with this. Really. I'll ask again - why us?

topics.prompt: I never said anything about paying you.

responses.text: [SUCCEEDED] {grudgingly} I can't believe you've actually talked me into this. {sigh} Fine, I'm in, but don't expect me to hold my fire if any NCR troops get in the way.

topics.prompt: The Remnants come in, guns blazing, showing the NCR how it's done. You actually don't want that?
topics.label: < Speech 80 >

responses.text: [FAILED] Sorry, but there's no glory in helping out the NCR.

topics.prompt: This is a chance for one more moment of glory.
topics.label: < Speech 80 >

responses.text: So you help them at the Dam only to screw them over big time later? {sigh} All right, I'll go along with this, then. I hope I don't regret it.

topics.prompt: {NCR - Wild Child}I work against the NCR as much as I work for them. This is no different.

responses.text: I've known them far longer than you have. They'll get over it.

topics.prompt: What will your friends think about this?

responses.text: {menace} Change of plan - you'll find that I've sealed the doors to this hangar - I don't want my friends getting involved in our little disagreement.
Once I'm done with you, I'll talk them out of this stupid plan. You've opened some old wounds - it's only fair I return the favor.

topics.prompt: Goodbye.

responses.text: Getting my gear, what does it look like? What, you think I'm going to leave this here for someone like you? I don't think so.

topics.prompt: What are you doing?

responses.text: No amount of caps will ever repay what the NCR robbed from me.

topics.prompt: Will caps change your mind?

responses.text: {slowly repeating player} You haven't decided - {sarcasm} well, this is just getting better every second, isn't it?

topics.prompt: I haven't decided.

responses.text: No, I'm done talking.

topics.prompt: We don't have to fight. We can still talk about this.

responses.text: Let's see what you've got.

topics.prompt: Come and get me.

responses.text: I wouldn't mind cutting down a few platoons of NCR troopers with my old gatling laser.

topics.prompt: Do you have a preference?

responses.text: Yeah, it does. There's not a chance you'll find me helping the NCR in any way. They've caused me too much grief.

topics.prompt: Does it matter who we help?

responses.text: I was a soldier. Why do you even care? I came out here to forget about the past, so quit bringing it up.

topics.prompt: So what did you do before you were retired?

responses.text: {Orion agrees to come} Oh, I'll come, but depending on the plan, I might not be staying. Keep that in mind.

topics.prompt: So you're not coming?

responses.text: {Orion agrees to come} All right, then - I'll show up at this gathering of yours. It might be good to see the others - {scowling} Johnson excluded.
Arcade might've mentioned there's a pass phrase needed to get into the bunker - my part is "Remember."

topics.prompt: I want to help the Legion defeat the NCR.

responses.text: Heavy weapons trooper. {grim glee} Nothing better than hosing down a target with an excess of bullets and laser fire.
By the time I got through with things, not much was left standing. Any morons who didn't run when they saw me coming got what they deserved.
Back then, it was war. {growling} If we'd been on the winning side, I'd be called a hero.

topics.prompt: What did you do when you were with the Enclave?

responses.text: {dismissive grunt} Hmmph.

topics.prompt: Goodbye.

responses.text: For Navarro!
{grim satisfaction} Just like old times.
